verdict.rationale: Procurement intake is a fair question for a spend-management platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no contract parsing and no procurement request forms. The closest feature is 'smart invoice scanning technology' that fills in payment recipient details, but invoices and payment forms are an adjacent capability, not AI parsing of vendor contracts into procurement requests.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor contracts parsed by AI to auto-populate procurement request forms
